result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall, with no overlapping, misaligned, or broken elements. The only findings are minor content and contrast concerns. The clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are excluded as intended scroll/viewport behavior.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (delivery fees such as '€0.90 delivery', rating count '(500+)', and the bottom navigation labels 'Search', 'Orders', 'Profile') is light gray on white, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios and reduce readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for normal text).

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice, once in the image badge and again in the metadata line, which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in only one location on the card.

issues.description: The '–100%' badge on the pizza card has no context (100% off what, and on which items), so its meaning is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear label such as '100% off first order' or remove the badge if the promotion is not explained elsewhere.
